source_refs.note: Exercise 10.1, Question 16 (book p. 278); the book prints no answers for Exercise 10.1; answers checked with sympy and the solution book

blocks.explanation:
Yeh Q15 jaisa hi sawal hai, bas angle \(2x\) hai aur dono terms ke beech minus hai.
Diya kya hai? \(\sin^3 2x\cos 2x - \cos^3 2x\sin 2x = \frac{\sqrt{2}}{8}\).
Find kya karna hai? \([0, 2\pi]\) ke saare solutions aur general solution.
Rule: common factor, phir double-angle formulas do dafa (pehle \(4x\) tak, phir \(8x\) tak).
Plan: \(\sin 8x\) ki value nikalna, angle \(8x\) ke jawab likhna, aur aakhir mein 8 se divide karna. Angle bara ho to jawab bhi zyada hote hain, is liye ginti dhyan se.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(\sin^3 2x\cos 2x - \cos^3 2x\sin 2x = \frac{\sqrt{2}}{8}\).
Maloom karna: \([0, 2\pi]\) mein solutions aur general solution.
Tareeqa: \(\sin 2x\cos 2x\) common nikalenge. Phir \(2\sin\theta\cos\theta = \sin 2\theta\) aur \(\cos^2\theta - \sin^2\theta = \cos 2\theta\) lagayenge, pehle \(\theta = 2x\) ke saath aur phir \(\theta = 4x\) ke saath. Yeh formulas har angle par kaam karte hain, sirf \(x\) par nahi.

Common factor bahar nikalein
\[\sin 2x\cos 2x(\sin^2 2x - \cos^2 2x)\]
\[= \tfrac{\sqrt{2}}{8}\]
Kyun: pehli term mein \(\sin 2x\cos 2x \cdot \sin^2 2x\) aur doosri mein \(\sin 2x\cos 2x \cdot \cos^2 2x\) chhupa hai. Common nikalne se bracket mein \(\sin^2 2x - \cos^2 2x\) bachta hai; yahan Q15 ki tarah plus nahi, minus hai, is liye yeh 1 nahi banega.

Har factor ko angle \(4x\) mein likhein
\[\sin 2x\cos 2x = \tfrac{1}{2}\sin 4x\]
\[\sin^2 2x - \cos^2 2x = -\cos 4x\]
Kyun: \(\sin 4x = 2\sin 2x\cos 2x\), is liye \(\sin 2x\cos 2x\) us ka aadha hai. Aur \(\cos 4x = \cos^2 2x - \sin^2 2x\) hai; hamare bracket mein order ulta hai (pehle sine), is liye woh \(-\cos 4x\) hai.
Dhyan dein: yeh minus bhool gaye to \(\sin 8x = +\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\) aayega aur saare jawab ghalat ho jayenge.

\(\sin 8x\) tak pohanchein
\[-\tfrac{1}{2}\sin 4x\cos 4x = \tfrac{\sqrt{2}}{8}\]
\[-\tfrac{1}{4}(2\sin 4x\cos 4x) = \tfrac{\sqrt{2}}{8}\]
\[-\tfrac{1}{4}\sin 8x = \tfrac{\sqrt{2}}{8}\]
\[\sin 8x = -\tfrac{\sqrt{2}}{2} = -\tfrac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\]
Kyun: \(\frac{1}{2}\) ko \(\frac{1}{4} \cdot 2\) likha taa ke bracket mein \(2\sin 4x\cos 4x\) ban jaye, jo double-angle formula se \(\sin 8x\) hai. Phir dono taraf ko \(-4\) se multiply kiya: \(\frac{\sqrt{2}}{8} \times (-4) = -\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}\).

Angle \(8x\) ke liye hal karein
\[8x = \pi + \tfrac{\pi}{4} + 2n\pi = \tfrac{5\pi}{4} + 2n\pi\]
\[8x = 2\pi - \tfrac{\pi}{4} + 2n\pi = \tfrac{7\pi}{4} + 2n\pi\]
Kyun: sine negative hai, to angle teesre (III) ya chauthe (IV) quadrant mein hai, reference angle \(\frac{\pi}{4}\) (kyunke \(\sin\frac{\pi}{4} = \frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\)). Yeh bilkul Example 1 wala tareeqa hai. Sine ka period \(2\pi\), is liye \(2n\pi\) joda.

8 se divide karein
\[x = \tfrac{5\pi}{32} + \tfrac{n\pi}{4}\]
\[x = \tfrac{7\pi}{32} + \tfrac{n\pi}{4}\]
Kyun: \(\frac{5\pi}{4} \div 8 = \frac{5\pi}{32}\) aur \(\frac{2n\pi}{8} = \frac{n\pi}{4}\). Period bhi 8 se divide hota hai; isi liye jawab ghane (qareeb qareeb) ho jate hain.

\([0, 2\pi]\) mein values (\(n = 0, 1, \ldots, 7\))
\[\tfrac{5\pi}{32}, \tfrac{13\pi}{32}, \tfrac{21\pi}{32}, \tfrac{29\pi}{32},\]
\[\tfrac{37\pi}{32}, \tfrac{45\pi}{32}, \tfrac{53\pi}{32}, \tfrac{61\pi}{32}\]
\[\tfrac{7\pi}{32}, \tfrac{15\pi}{32}, \tfrac{23\pi}{32}, \tfrac{31\pi}{32},\]
\[\tfrac{39\pi}{32}, \tfrac{47\pi}{32}, \tfrac{55\pi}{32}, \tfrac{63\pi}{32}\]
Kyun: \(\frac{n\pi}{4} = \frac{8n\pi}{32}\), yani har qadam par numerator mein 8 jurta hai. \(n = 8\) par value \(2\pi = \frac{64\pi}{32}\) se aage nikal jati hai. Jab \(x\) ek chakkar lagata hai to \(8x\) aath chakkar lagata hai, aur har chakkar mein do jawab, is liye kul \(8 \times 2 = 16\) jawab.
Ginti ka aasaan tareeqa: pehli family ke numerators 5, 13, 21, ... aur doosri ke 7, 15, 23, ...; dono 8 ke qadam se chalte hain.

Tasdeeq: \(x = \frac{5\pi}{32}\)
\[8x = \tfrac{5\pi}{4},\quad \sin 8x = -\tfrac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\]
\[\text{L.H.S.} = -\tfrac{1}{4}\left(-\tfrac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\right)\]
\[= \tfrac{1}{4\sqrt{2}} = \tfrac{\sqrt{2}}{8} \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: step 4 mein dekha tha ke left side \(-\frac{1}{4}\sin 8x\) ke barabar hai. \(\frac{1}{4\sqrt{2}}\) ko \(\frac{\sqrt{2}}{\sqrt{2}}\) se multiply karein (rationalise) to \(\frac{\sqrt{2}}{8}\) milta hai, jo right side hai.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text: Kitab mein Exercise 10.1 ke jawab chhape hue nahi hain. Is page ka har jawab hamara apna hai: qadam ba qadam hal kiya gaya, computer algebra system (sympy) se alag se check kiya gaya, aur ek solution book se bhi milaya gaya. Is liye aap apna jawab yahan wale jawab se mila kar dekh sakte hain.
